scripts.infra:up: docker compose -p snack-rate-dev -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.development up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -p snack-rate-dev -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.development down
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -p snack-rate-dev -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml --env-file .env.development logs -f
scripts.infra:restart: pnpm run infra:down && pnpm run infra:up
scripts.proxy:restart: pnpm run proxy:down && pnpm run proxy:up
scripts.staging:up: docker compose -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging up -d
scripts.staging:down: docker compose -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging down
scripts.staging:logs: docker compose -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging logs -f
scripts.staging:restart: pnpm run staging:down && pnpm run staging:up
scripts.staging:db:migrate: docker compose --profile tools -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging run --rm db-tool
scripts.staging:db:seed: docker compose --profile tools -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging run --rm db-tool node ./drizzle/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.staging:db:reset: docker compose --profile tools -p snack-rate-staging -f compose.yml -f compose.staging.yml --env-file .env.staging run --rm db-tool node ./drizzle/scripts/reset.ts
scripts.prod:up: docker compose -p snack-rate-prod -f compose.yml -f compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production up -d
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -p snack-rate-prod -f compose.yml -f compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production down
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -p snack-rate-prod -f compose.yml -f compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production logs -f
scripts.prod:db:migrate: docker compose --profile tools -p snack-rate-prod -f compose.yml -f compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production run --rm db-tool
scripts.prod:restart: pnpm run prod:down && pnpm run prod:up
